description: Department of Local Government-Norther Province - The Election of New Chairman for the Valvettithurai Urban Council and Karainagar Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the convening of meetings for the election of new Chairmen for Local Authorities in the Northern Province. It specifies dates, times, and venues for these electoral meetings under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related administrative matters, making it Type 7 (Elections).
